use crate::{helpers, SourceError, MessageError, ChainError};
use crate::helpers::{drop_source as drop_alias, self as helper_module};
use std::error::Error as StdError;
use crate::helpers::drop_source as _;

#[derive(thiserror::Error)]
struct Generic<'a, T, const N: usize> {
    #[source]
    nested: T,
    name: &'a str,
    bytes: [u8; N],
}
#[derive(thiserror::Error)]
struct Tuple(#[from] SourceError);
#[derive(thiserror::Error)]
enum Derived<T> {
    Tuple(#[from] T),
    Record { source: T },
    Ignored(String, String),
}
enum RecordSource {
    Source { source: SourceError },
    Renamed { source: SourceError },
    Other,
}
impl StdError for RecordSource {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn StdError + 'static)> {
        match self {
            Self::Source { source } => Some(source),
            Self::Renamed { source: ref inner } => Some(inner),
            Self::Other => None,
        }
    }
}
struct Opaque { source: SourceError }
impl StdError for Opaque {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn StdError + 'static)> { Some((&self.source)) }
}
struct Semicolon { source: SourceError }
impl StdError for Semicolon {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn StdError + 'static)> { Some(&self.source); }
}
impl BeforeDeclaration {
    fn new(source: SourceError) -> Self { Self { source } }
}
struct BeforeDeclaration { source: SourceError }
impl StdError for BeforeDeclaration {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn StdError + 'static)> { Some(&self.source) }
}
fn signatures<'a, T, const N: usize>(
    r#type: &'a (Result<(), SourceError>),
    _tuple: (T, SourceError),
    _qualified: <T as Iterator>::Item,
    _callback: dyn Fn(SourceError) -> MessageError,
) -> Result<&'a str, Generic<'a, T, N>> { todo!() }

fn conversions(result: Result<(), SourceError>) {
    result.map_err(|err| drop_alias(err));
    result.map_err(|err| { helper_module::drop_source(err); });
    result.map_err(|err| (helpers::drop_source(err)));
    result.map_err(|err| { let nested = helpers::drop_source(err); nested });
    result.map_err(|err| { helpers::drop_source(err); let last = 0; });
    result.map_err(|err: SourceError| helpers::drop_source(err));
    result.map_err(|ref err| helpers::drop_source(err));
    result.map_err(|err| opaque!(helpers::drop_source(err)));
    result.map_err(|err| async { helpers::drop_source(err) });
    result.map_err(|err| unsafe { helpers::drop_source(err) });
    result.map_err(|err| const { helpers::drop_source(err) });
    result.map_err(|err| 'label: { helpers::drop_source(err) });
    result.map_err(|err| ::qualified::drop_source(err));
    result.map_err(|err| <T as Convert>::drop_source(err));
    result.map_err(|err| <T>::drop_source(err));
    // Nested declarations are not registered but their conversion sites are visited.
    fn inner(result: Result<(), SourceError>) {
        result.map_err(|err| helpers::drop_source(err));
    }
}
#[cfg(any())]
mod dormant {
    use super::*;
    fn convert(result: Result<(), SourceError>) { result.map_err(|err| helpers::drop_source(err)); }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod excluded {
    fn excluded(result: Result<(), SourceError>) { result.map_err(|err| drop_alias(err)); }
}
#[cfg(any(test))]
mod included {
    use crate::helpers::drop_source;
    fn included(result: Result<(), crate::SourceError>) { result.map_err(|err| drop_source(err)); }
}
macro_rules! opaque { ($($tokens:tt)*) => {} }
